headline_en: 0 after audit · Oct Fed gap 25.8pp (Altınla) vs 2.9pp (Investing)
headline_zh: 审计后 0 条 · 十月美联储缺口 25.8pp（Altınla）对 2.9pp（Investing）
sub_en: 772 markets scanned. 2 raw “edges.” 0 survived fees and a full exclusive set. Book depth checked at $100/$500 (as of 2026-10-08 11:24 CST). Economic mismatch flag on the primary source: PM +25bp mid 0.155 vs Altınla CME hike-bin 0.413 (gap 25.8pp). Secondary Investing hike-bin 0.184 (gap 2.9pp) — both read the same ZQV26 96.115 yet disagree by 22.9pp, so the gap is a method question, not an arbitrage.
sub_zh: 扫描 772 个市场。原始“优势” 2 条。扣费且互斥组完整后 0 条。盘口深度已按 $100/$500 核验（截至 2026-10-08 11:24 CST）。主源出现经济错配标记：PM +25bp mid 0.155 对 Altınla CME 加息档 0.413（缺口 25.8pp）。次源 Investing 加息档 0.184（缺口 2.9pp）——两者读的是同一个 ZQV26 96.115，却差 22.9pp，所以这是换算方法问题，不是套利。

fee.note_zh: feesEnabled 时用该市场 feeSchedule.rate，不默认 0。

fed.cme_source: Altınla FedWatch PRIMARY (bins_sane) / ZQV26 96.115 · Oct28 hold(3.75–4.00)=0.587 hike(4.00–4.25)=0.413 · asof Updated: October 8, 2026 at 01:55 AM UTC · Yahoo ZQV26.CBT fetch returned HTTP 403 this run (no independent futures confirm) · Investing secondary hike=0.184 hold=0.816 (Oct 07, 2026 10:15PM EDT), same future 96.115
fed.note_en: October watch. PM exclusive +25bp mid 0.155 vs Altınla CME-method hike-bin 0.413 (gap 25.8pp) — mismatch_flag true (≥~8–10pp). Investing secondary hike=0.184 (gap 2.9pp, below threshold). Both sources quote the same ZQV26 96.115 but map it 22.9pp apart, so the flag rests on one source's day-weight/baseline assumption. Buying the whole NegRisk set costs 1.0271 after 5% fees — no edge. Contracts are not identical (CME 4.00–4.25 bin ≈ PM exclusive +25bp only from current 3.75–4.00). Paper inconsistency mark, not a trade.
fed.note_zh: 十月观察。PM 独家 +25bp mid 0.155 对 Altınla CME 方法加息档 0.413（缺口 25.8 个百分点）——错配标记 true（≥约 8–10pp）。Investing 次源加息档 0.184（缺口 2.9pp，未过阈值）。两个来源报的是同一个 ZQV26 96.115，换算结果却差 22.9pp，所以这个标记取决于单一来源的日权重/基准假设。整组 NegRisk 扣 5% 费后成本 1.0271，无边。合约不完全相同（CME 4.00–4.25 档仅在当前 3.75–4.00 时约等于 PM 独家 +25bp）。只是纸面不一致标记，不是交易。
fed.recheck_en: Re-check if: (1) contracts are definition-matched, AND (2) NegRisk net cost/share < 1 after live feeSchedule, AND (3) the expensive legs still have size, OR |PM−CME gap| ≥ ~8–10pp on matched bins.
fed.recheck_zh: 重检条件：定义对齐，且 NegRisk 扣现费后净成本 < 1，且贵的那几条仍有深度；或对齐档上 |PM−CME| 缺口 ≥ 约 8–10 个百分点。

receipt.title: Nobel Peace Prize Winner 2026
receipt.missing: Event lists 71 markets: 42 active named candidates, 28 inactive “Person W…AX” placeholders and an inactive “Other” leg. A laureate not on the active list pays every bought Yes leg 0.
receipt.reason_en: Scanner summed the 42 active named candidates: gross 0.856, net 0.8962 after 5% fees. That set is not exhaustive — the ‘Other’ leg and 28 placeholder slots are inactive, so the ~14¢ gap is the market's price on an unlisted winner (or no award), not free money. Not a fee-adjusted edge. A second raw hit (Presidential Election Winner 2028, net 0.9554) was rejected for the same placeholder reason.
receipt.reason_zh: 扫描加总了 42 位在册具名候选：毛 0.856，扣 5% 费后净 0.8962。这个集合不穷尽——“其他”腿和 28 个占位名都未激活，所以约 14¢ 的缺口是市场给“名单外得主（或不颁奖）”的价格，不是白送的钱。不是扣费后的优势。另一条原始命中（2028 总统选举胜者，净 0.9554）同样因占位腿被否。
receipt.recheck_en: Only counts if an active Other/field leg exists and is included, with sum(ask)+fees < 1 above dust. The October announcement will settle it either way.
receipt.recheck_zh: 只有当“其他/场外”腿激活并计入，且 sum(ask)+费 < 1 且深度非尘埃时才算。十月公布后自然结算。

scan.near_miss_filter_en: Raw near-misses are Yes+No (or exclusive-set) net within a few cents of $1. Most are longshot dust. Watch list keeps incomplete partitions and the live Fed book.
scan.near_miss_filter_zh: 原始近失是 Yes+No（或互斥组）扣费后净成本离 $1 只差几分。多数是长尾尘埃。观察名单只留分区不完整、以及在轨的美联储盘。
scan.count_rule_en: 772 = 761 Yes/No books + 11 NegRisk events. Full set in universe.json.
scan.count_rule_zh: 772 = 761 个 Yes/No 盘 + 11 个 NegRisk 事件。全集在 universe.json。

method.en: Audit, not a teaser. Scan exclusive NegRisk Yes-asks; reject any incomplete partition; apply that market’s feeSchedule.rate (fee = C × rate × p × (1−p); rebate ignored). A Fed gap counts only if contracts are definition-matched. Scorecards freeze T−2h modal Yes mid vs BLS first print. Book depth: equal-share walk down the asks at $100/$500 per set (depth_check). Engine stays private; every number on this page is in desk.json.
method.zh: 这是审计，不是预告页。扫互斥 NegRisk 的 Yes 卖一；分区不完整就否；用该市场 feeSchedule.rate（fee = C × rate × p × (1−p)，忽略返佣）。利率缺口只在定义对齐时才算。记分卡用 T−2h 众数 Yes mid 对 BLS 首次。盘口深度：按每组 $100/$500 等股数沿卖单回溯（depth_check）。引擎不公开；这页每个数都在 desk.json。

history_policy.en: A freeze is pre-print only if the GitHub commit time is before the official release. CPI 11 Sep and NFP 4 Sep freezes were internal; first public copy is the 14 Sep 10:20 snapshot (commit c32856a). 14–16 Sep snapshots are public pre-print freezes for FOMC 15–16 Sep. Sep NFP public pre-print freeze is ship 2026-10-01-1051 (commit c416920); its print result is appended as 2026-10-05-nfp-print without rewriting freeze rows. Results are append-only.
history_policy.zh: 只有 GitHub commit 时间早于官方公布，冻盘才算事前。CPI 9/11 和非农 9/4 的冻结当时只在内部；第一次公开是 9/14 10:20 快照（commit c32856a）。9/14–16 快照是 9/15–16 FOMC 的事前公开冻结。9 月非农公开事前冻盘是船 2026-10-01-1051（commit c416920）；其公布结果以 2026-10-05-nfp-print 追加，冻盘行不改写。结果只追加。

depth_check.line_en: Book depth checked at $100/$500 (as of 2026-10-08 11:24 CST)
depth_check.method_en: Buy equal shares of every leg down the public CLOB asks until the stake (incl. fees) is spent. Fee per level = shares × feeSchedule.rate × p × (1−p). max_profitable_sets = largest set size whose average cost after fees stays < $1. One snapshot of visible asks; not a fill guarantee. Sets marked set_complete=false are not exhaustive, so their “edge” is nominal.
depth_check.method_zh: 沿公开 CLOB 卖单，每条腿买相同股数，直到本金（含费）花完。每档费用 = 股数 × feeSchedule.rate × p × (1−p)。max_profitable_sets = 扣费后平均成本仍 < $1 的最大组数。只是某一刻的可见卖单，不保证成交。set_complete=false 的集合不穷尽，其“优势”只是名义值。
